source_clauses.verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine,
and when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement_verbatim: a foot pedal for a workbench
requirements.observable_verbatim: a surface a foot presses, located at a workbench

requirements.statement_verbatim: Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
requirements.observable_verbatim: a signal produced when the pressed surface is displaced

requirements.statement_verbatim: when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own
requirements.observable_verbatim: the pressed surface returning to its resting position with no user action
the proportion of presses after which the resting position is regained

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should not move if something brushes against it sideways
requirements.observable_verbatim: displacement of the pressed surface under a sideways disturbance

actors.name: operator

scenarios.name: installation at the workbench
